media.title: Roger Edens with Lena Horne — The Omaha Guide, 1945
media.description: Faithful portrait crop from a press photograph published in The Omaha Guide on 3 March 1945. The printed caption identifies the seated man as producer-composer Roger Edens and the standing singer as Lena Horne. The crop preserves the original newspaper halftone without generative restoration or reconstruction.
media.altText: Black-and-white halftone portrait crop of Roger Edens in a suit and patterned bow tie, looking slightly upward.
media.rightsNote: Reuse rights are not cleared. The Library of Congress states that newspapers in Chronicling America published less than ninety-five years ago are believed to be in the public domain or to have no known restrictions, but may contain copyrighted third-party material. This 1945 photograph is credited to Calvin’s News Service, and no item-level rights determination or renewal check has been located. A faithful 430 × 560 pixel crop is used here for scholarly identification; no restoration or reconstruction has been applied.
